proposals.answer: When a feature comes into the slice, the plan play adds one story for it, so that each feature of the slice has a story; it makes no second story for a feature that has one; and nothing goes to the tracker before the product owner's yes. What it does with the story of a feature that goes out is not set by the model: the product owner says.

basis.ref: product/product-os/software-delivery-planning/cap-718/fn-818/feature.md:20-22 (a second run makes no copies; nothing goes to the tracker before the yes; what the play does when the slice changes is not set yet) and :44-46 (fails if a feature of the slice has no story, or a second story is made for one feature)

proposals.context: The plan feature's page says the rule for a changed slice is not set yet; it only says each feature must have exactly one story and nothing reaches the tracker before the product owner's yes.

proposals.answer: The eval is written in the plan's evals folder (.garura/project/plans/<plan-id>/evals/<slug>/). For each goal and expectation of the stories, and each failure condition of the slice's hidden file, it holds one check run from the outside on the slice's surface (for Garura often a run of the play on a test project), or a note that it cannot be tested yet. The layout of the file itself is not set by the model: the product owner says.

basis.ref: product/product-os/software-delivery-planning/shape-eval/fn-798/feature.md:11-13 (one eval in the plan's evals folder; the format is not set yet), :18-20 (checks from the outside on the slice's surface, often a play on a test project; says when it cannot test a line yet) and :25 (each goal, expectation and failure condition has a check or a note)

proposals.context: The eval feature's page sets where the eval goes and what each check covers, but says its format is not set yet.

basis.ref: product/product-os/software-delivery-planning/shape-slice/fn-795/feature.md:22 (a part with no ICE gets a thin ICE, marked thin, and the person is never sent back); product/product-os/capabilities/cap-723/capability.md:11 (partly ready: the ICE goes forward and work starts)

proposals.why: Yes. The slice feature's page says the play proposes a thin ICE, marks it thin, warns the person and never sends them back; the ready check calls a part with gaps like that partly ready, and work goes on.

basis.ref: product/product-os/intents/bi-788.md:14 (each of the three plays ends at one confirmation by the product owner); product/product-os/software-delivery-planning/shape-slice/fn-795/feature.md:34 (the loop and its one approval, #796, are out of scope)

proposals.why: Yes. The confirmed intent's proof says each of the three plays ends at one confirmation by the product owner; the loop's one approval (#796) is out of scope.

basis.ref: product/product-os/software-delivery-planning/shape-eval/capability.md:19-23 (write only in the plan's evals folder; fails if a builder can read the eval; until #828 only a read rule keeps the folder from builders); product/product-os/software-delivery-planning/shape-eval/fn-798/feature.md:21 (until eval encryption, only a read rule keeps builders out)

proposals.why: In the plan's evals folder, .garura/project/plans/<plan-id>/evals/<slug>/, which no builder, building skill or context sub-agent reads; until eval encryption (#828) only a read rule keeps builders out.
